  (input wclk, input wrst_n, input winc, input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata, output wfull,
   input rclk, input rrst_n, input rinc, output [WIDTH-1:0] rdata, output rempty);

  function integer clog2;
    input integer value;
    integer i;
    begin
      clog2 = 0;
      for (i = value - 1; i > 0; i = i >> 1)
        clog2 = clog2 + 1;
    end
  endfunction

  localparam ADDRSIZE = clog2(DEPTH);
  localparam ASIZE    = ADDRSIZE + 1;

  reg [WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];

  reg [ASIZE-1:0] wbin, wgray, rbin, rgray;
  reg [ASIZE-1:0] wq1_rgray, wq2_rgray;
  reg [ASIZE-1:0] rq1_wgray, rq2_wgray;
  reg             wfull_r, rempty_r;

  wire [ASIZE-1:0] wbin_next, wgray_next;
  wire [ASIZE-1:0] rbin_next, rgray_next;
  wire             wfull_val;
  wire             rempty_val;

  assign wbin_next  = wbin + (winc & ~wfull_r);
  assign wgray_next = (wbin_next >> 1) ^ wbin_next;
  assign rbin_next  = rbin + (rinc & ~rempty_r);
  assign rgray_next = (rbin_next >> 1) ^ rbin_next;

  generate
    if (ASIZE == 2) begin : g_full
      assign wfull_val = (wgray_next == {~wq2_rgray[1], wq2_rgray[0]});
    end else begin : g_full
      assign wfull_val = (wgray_next == {~wq2_rgray[ASIZE-1:ASIZE-2], wq2_rgray[ASIZE-3:0]});
    end
  endgenerate

  assign rempty_val = (rgray_next == rq2_wgray);

  // ---- write clock domain ----
  always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrst_n) begin
    if (!wrst_n) begin
      wbin    <= 0;
      wgray   <= 0;
      wfull_r <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      wbin    <= wbin_next;
      wgray   <= wgray_next;
      wfull_r <= wfull_val;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrst_n) begin
    if (!wrst_n) begin
      wq1_rgray <= 0;
      wq2_rgray <= 0;
    end else begin
      wq1_rgray <= rgray;
      wq2_rgray <= wq1_rgray;
    end
  end

  // ---- read clock domain ----
  always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrst_n) begin
    if (!rrst_n) begin
      rbin     <= 0;
      rgray    <= 0;
      rempty_r <= 1'b1;
    end else begin
      rbin     <= rbin_next;
      rgray    <= rgray_next;
      rempty_r <= rempty_val;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrst_n) begin
    if (!rrst_n) begin
      rq1_wgray <= 0;
      rq2_wgray <= 0;
    end else begin
      rq1_wgray <= wgray;
      rq2_wgray <= rq1_wgray;
    end
  end

  // ---- memory ----
  always @(posedge wclk) begin
    if (winc & ~wfull_r)
      mem[wbin[ADDRSIZE-1:0]] <= wdata;
  end

  assign rdata  = mem[rbin[ADDRSIZE-1:0]];
  assign wfull  = wfull_r;
  assign rempty = rempty_r;

endmodule
